image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional hairstyle-analysis teaching image for a mobile training app
Primary request: Create a realistic 2-by-2 contact sheet documenting the CURRENT hairstyle of one fictional adult East Asian woman from four consistent views: front, exact right profile, exact left profile, and exact back.
Scene/backdrop: identical plain warm light-gray studio background in every panel.
Subject: the exact same fictional adult in every panel, natural unretouched skin, neutral expression, relatively small-scale facial features, long slender visible neck, narrow gently sloping shoulders, and a simple matte charcoal-gray wide crew-neck top. Current hair is a dense, medium-coarse, mostly straight collarbone-length blunt lob with a slight natural bend underneath; weight and maximum width collect around the jaw-to-upper-neck area, ends spread subtly outward when they meet the shoulders, crown is comparatively quiet and compact, no bangs, natural center-to-soft-off-center part. Dark natural brown hair with realistic individual strands and ordinary shine.
Style/medium: highly realistic neutral salon documentation photography, no beauty filter or glamour retouching.
Composition/framing: landscape 2-by-2 contact sheet, four equal panels, same camera height, subject scale, focal length, crop and lighting; complete head, hair outline, baseline, neck, both shoulders and upper chest visible.
Constraints: same identity, face, head, neck and shoulder proportions, clothing, current haircut, density pattern and bend pattern in all panels; current condition only, no proposed result, labels, arrows, logos, watermark or text.
Avoid: fashion posing, exaggerated shoulders, changed identity or haircut, cropped head or shoulders, makeover, heavy curls, wet hair, medical hair-loss appearance.
